Happy Birthday, Eruma! 🐃🎂

(Tap pannina fast-a varum ⚡)

Namma school la celebrate panra last birthday idhu 🏫🎂 Yosichu paatha, evlo seekiram time odiduchu la? 🥺⏳

Indha school life la unna maari oru best friend kedaichadhu en life-oda periya blessing. Namma sirichadhu 😂, sandai pottadhu 😤, ellame life-long ninaivu 📸✨

School mudinjadhum namma vera vera vazhila pogalam, aana namma friendship eppavum maaradhu. Nee enga irundhaalum, enakku nee eppavum en Pig dhaan 💜

Indha varusham unakku ellame nalladhaa nadakkanum 🌈 Nee ninaikkura ellame kedaikkanum 🎯 Unakkaaga naan eppavum irukken 🤗

Eppavum sirichute iru, santhoshama iru. Un smile dhaan best 😄🌸 Kavalai ellam dhooram pogattum, happiness mattum un kooda irukkattum 🥳🎈

Innaiku full-a nee dhaan queen 👑 Last school bday nalla enjoy pannu 🎉💖

Happy Birthday to my bestieee! 🎉🥳 Nee en best friend mattum illa, en forever person 💞, en safe place 🏡, en biggest blessing 🌸. Nee en kooda irukkum bodhu life romba azhagaa irukku ✨. Un smile en worst days-ayum best days-a maathidum 😊🌈, un presence enakku romba peace tharudhu 🕊️.

Naan onnum sollama-ye nee ennai purinjukkuva 🥹, adhu romba special 💖. En highs, en lows, en craziness 🤪, en kanneer 😢, en kanavugal 🌙 ellaathaiyum paathutu, nee innum en kooda irukka 🤗.

Un kooda irukkura ovvoru nimishamum priceless 💎 nonstop-a sirichaalum 😂, deep-a emotional-a pesinaalum 💭, illa summa amaidhi-a ukkandhirundhaalum 🫂. Naan ovvoru naalum unakkaaga romba nandri solren 🙏💕

Un special day 🎂 la unakku endless happiness 😄, success 🏆, nalla health 🍀, ulagathula irukkura ella anbum kedaikkanum 🌍❤️. Un kanavu ellame nijam aaganum ⭐, life eppavum unna sirikka vechukitte irukkanum 😊. Nee eppavum ippadi azhagaana manasoda irukkanum, always and forever! 👑💜

— Un best friend 💜
